    Big circles take longer to manifest. While a medium circle draws itself you move at half speed; a large one roots you in place.

    How the magic works

    A circle is a spell. The element in its core reaches every form on its rings: a bolt, an orb, a wall, and later a nova, a beam or a meteor. Modifiers beside a form change it (split, seek, pierce; explode, timed, near).

    Knowing more means writing less. A shape copies its top corner to its other corners (Symmetry). A glyph on an outer ring reaches every form inside it (Scope). Matching elements facing each other across a ring resonate (Opposition). A saved circle can be written into another as one seal (Naming). Two more laws are learned out in the world: written upside down, some glyphs do their opposite (Inversion), and a circle that carries its own seal goes off again where it ends (Recursion). The fewer glyphs, the less ink, the faster it draws and the sooner it is back.

    Circles can overlap. In Weave mode, how deep two circles overlap decides what they share: triggers, behaviors, a merged form, or fused elements (fire and water make steam). Glyphs that line up exactly connect.

    The world teaches. Shrines teach elements, stones carved with glyphs teach forms, the mentor's challenges teach economy, and some spells hide secrets of their own. Trials, duels and the Archon give your book more ink, new inks and rare bindings.

    Settings

    Graphics
    Spellbook backup
    Tips
    Creative mode

    For testing: infinite ink, no cooldowns, nothing can hurt you, and you know everything (every element, law, fused element, carved glyph, ink, binding, duelist and hidden combo). Turning it off brings back your own knowledge and records exactly as they were; spells you wrote stay in your book. In live duels and trials together it pauses.

    Start over

    This erases your spellbook, knowledge, shrines and records. Click again to confirm.

    Choose your opponent

    Every duelist reads your circles: the longer one takes to manifest, the more likely they dodge it. Beat one to face the next.

    Choose your starting element

    Your mentor taught you fire, water and storm. The element you choose now is yours: its glyphs cost you half ink. The rest wait in the shrines around the Training Grounds, through the gate south of the Academy.
